title: Durable, rate-capable and high-energy hybrid supercapacitor from PANI/ZnO/SnO2 nanocomposite with zero-waste electrolyte approach
content:
Energy Adv., 2025, 4,666-682
DOI: 10.1039/D4YA00617H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Aranganathan Viswanathan, Vanchiappan Aravindan
The supercapacitors containing the composite of PANI, ZnO and SnO2 synthesized in single-step were tested using two electrolytes. The liquid by-product of PANI synthesis was used as an electrolyte for the fabrication (waste to wealth).
